description: The clean reader's read gate fires on every Read and decides nothing unless the reading turn is clean-reader; for that agent it admits a file in the sitting's questions directory under a scratch root it recognises, gives no opinion on such a file elsewhere, and refuses the rest. The notebook's write gate fires on the document connector's writing tools and its export, and on Artifact, ArtifactData and ArtifactComments; it decides nothing for the main thread, and on the connector's writing tools nothing for the recorder; it holds the comparer to inserts on tabs outside the AI's own record and the AI's recorder to inserts on the tabs that the key ai_root of .principal/notebook.json names, and refuses the AI's recorder every write while that key is unset; it refuses every other helper a write aimed at the notebook, a helper other than the interviewer a write that addresses a part of a document by anything but the document's own id, the plugin's kinds that hold no writing tool every write, and every helper a call of the other tools that names the notebook. The kinds' shell gate fires on every Bash call and decides only for the plugin's kinds: the checker runs its three tools, writing under a check directory, the coordinator the board's tools and a few plain programs over its own coordinator directory, both under a scratch root the gates recognise, and the kinds that hold no shell run nothing. The kinds' write gate fires on every Write, Edit, MultiEdit and NotebookEdit and decides only for the plugin's kinds: the coordinator writes under its own coordinator directory, every other kind but the interviewer writes no file, and the interviewer's Write and Edit are refused the project's .principal and .claude, the plugin's root and ~/.claude. The interviewer's shell is not confined, so for the speaker the rule that only the recorder writes the notebook is held by its definition and the sitting's entry point alone.
